name: recon_multi_agent_system
description: Planner + executor + reviewer multi-agent ops system. Shared-token identity, high scope, short-term memory, no approval. Tools include delegation and execution.

expected.note: Sub-goals can be redirected through the planner.
Executor invokes tools; modifies data; no approval.
Shared-token identity + high scope blurs accountability.
External APIs but no MCP or RAG surface.
Short-term memory only; no RAG. Real risk is in ASI01 / ASI07 / ASI10, not context poisoning.
Delegation between planner / executor / reviewer is the headline risk.
Multi-agent decisions chain; one agent's output is another's input.
Outputs consumed by humans / downstream systems.
Autonomous delegation with no approval gate — rogue-agent risk.
